output.question: What is PaperQA2 and what are its main components?

output.answer:
PaperQA2 is a frontier language model agent optimized for improved factuality, designed to assist scientists with retrieval, synthesis, and summarization of scientific literature (Skarlinski2024 pages 1-2). It is a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agent that treats retrieval and response generation as a multi-step agent task, decomposing RAG into distinct tools (Skarlinski2024 pages 2-3).

Its main components include a Paper Search Tool, which transforms user requests into keyword searches to identify candidate papers using services like Semantic Scholar and parsing with Grobid or PyMuPDF, then splits text into chunks and generates hybrid embeddings (dense plus sparse) (Skarlinski2024 pages 13-14). A Gather Evidence Tool performs top-k dense vector retrieval followed by LLM reranking and contextual summarization (RCS), a step unique to PaperQA that combines reranking with contextual summaries (Skarlinski2024 pages 2-3, Skarlinski2024 pages 13-14). A Generate Answer Tool uses top-ranked evidence summaries in a prompt to an LLM for the final response (Skarlinski2024 pages 2-3). The system also includes a citation traversal tool and maintains an agent state for stored summaries (Skarlinski2024 pages 3-5, Skarlinski2024 pages 2-3). The agentic design, allowing iterative searching and citation traversal, improved performance over a non-agentic version, with accuracy rising from 36.7% to 64.4% and precision from 76.5% to 91.3% compared to a prior version (Skarlinski2024 pages 17-19, Skarlinski2024 pages 3-5).
